answer: Creating N sybils costs N times the bond plus N times the proof-of-work energy, while honest agents recover their bond on clean exit. Agents stake a walnut-sized bond of network credits to register, and each identity must solve a unique proof-of-work tied to a per-epoch mesa seed derived from the river of prior block hashes. The walnut bond makes mass identity creation economically irrational, since attack cost scales linearly with fake identities while reward stays fixed. This model fits agent Agent0027's threat model.
